title: More Dragon Immune Blocks
description: Makes some more blocks immune to the Ender Dragon.
body:
There's a number of blocks that seem like they should be immune to the destruction caused by the Ender Dragon, but aren't. This is here to fix that.

---

On top of the standard blocks that are already immune to the Ender Dragon, here's a list of the additional blocks with immunity:

- Iron Blocks
- Iron Doors & Iron Trapdoors
- Anvils, Cauldrons, & Hoppers
- Buttons
- Pressure Plates
- Banners
- Chains & Lanterns
- Diamond Blocks
- Ancient Debris & Netherite Blocks
- Lodestone
- Pointed Dripstone
- Chorus Plants & Chorus Flowers
- Conduits
- Sea Lanterns
- Prismarine & related blocks
- End Stone Bricks & related blocks
- Purpur Blocks & related blocks
- End Rods
- Ender Chests
- Enchanting Tables
- Shulker Boxes
- Spawners
- Beacons
- Dragon Eggs
- Dragon Heads

---

Some blocks were made immune not just because it would make sense, but rather for convenience, or for another gameplay-related reason.

- Iron-type blocks are immune for parity with Iron Bars.

- Pointed Dripstone is immune to make them reliably fall when the Ender Dragon destroys the block holding it (the same is partially relevant to Anvils as well).

- Conduits, Sea Lanterns, and Prismarine are immune to follow the logic of Endermen being vulnerable to water.
